2026-09-09 13:53:39.487711 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-09-09 13:53:39.487725 | controller |
2026-09-09 13:53:39.487729 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-09 13:53:39.487733 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-09 13:53:39.487737 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-09 13:53:39.487749 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-09 13:53:39.487752 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-09 13:53:39.487756 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-09 13:53:39.487759 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
